newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST FIRST-TIER STOCKS CLING TO CENTRE-STAGE.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST FIRST-TIER STOCKS CLING TO CENTRE-STAGE.

text.p: Bucharest bourse first-tier
stocks Azomures SA and Oltchim SA once
again dominated trading on Wednesday, keeping turnover high at
1.6 billion lei.
But the two stocks moved downward under pressure from sell
notes, with Azomures fertiliser maker declining 250 lei to
1,350 at close and Oltchim shedding 600 lei to 1,050.
"The two stocks spent the morning at even lower quotes, of
around 850 lei, as buyers stuck to their bids," said a trader.
Investor interest in the other shares was damp and eight of
the 26 traded stocks had no deal.
Brokers said newcomer Policolor SA performed well
for its first day, trading more than 28,000 shares on turnover
of 34.6 million lei. Policolor headed higher to a 1,350 lei
close from an opening price of 1,200.
"Policolor is a good company, but I think today it was
overpriced. It closed as high as Azomures and the two cannot
compare," a broker said.
Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- fell from
the previous session by 2.3 and respectively 1.87 percent.
